title: Abamwumviriza Binyegeje Bemeye .
intro: Mu guceceka kw’ikoraniro ryeranda, ikoraniro ridasanzwe ryarashitse rivuye mu karere kataboneka. Bakwegerewe n’ugusemerera kw’ikintu gitangaje, bumviriza ugusubiramwo kwobaye gukingira iherezo ryabo ibihe bidahera. Intahe yabo iguma ari imwe mu nzira zidasanzwe mu vyanditswe vy’Imana.
clues: Turi ibiremwa biva mu karere benshi batabona, kandi twaje nk’umugwi.
Twarafashe urugendo tuja aho hari ikoraniro kugira ngo twumve ikintu kidasanzwe.
Twararemeye ku mugaragaro ko muri twebwe hari abagororotsi abandi na bo batagororotse.
Twari tuzi ko tutashobora guhunga itegeko ry’Imana kw’isi, canke mu guhunga tuja mw’ijuru.
Twumvise ubuyobozi, twabuvyemera; uwo wese yizeye Umukama wiwe ntazotinya guhomba canke umutwaro.
